title: SFMO Editor
subtitle: A specialized editor for managing, structuring, and visualizing .sfmo data files
description: SFMO Editor is a web application featuring Google Drive integration that allows you to open, edit, and manage custom .sfmo files directly from your cloud storage. It enables you to build structured data tables connected to multiple datasets and generate synthesized analytical dashboards.

features.title: Main Data Table
features.description: Supports Boolean, Text, and Number data types, along with direct references to stored datasets.

features.title: Multi-Dataset Support
features.description: Store and manage multiple independent datasets within the same file to reference in your main table.

features.title: Built-in Dashboards
features.description: Visualize synthesized metrics and data summaries generated directly from your main table.

features.title: Google Drive Integration
features.description: Seamlessly open and edit .sfmo files stored in your Google Drive storage.

how_to_use_ol: Access the web app or install the integration via Google Workspace Marketplace.
Right-click any .sfmo file inside Google Drive and select Open with > SFMO Editor.
Edit your main table, link datasets, or analyze your data using the built-in dashboard.
